description: Tamil Nadu's budget unveils AI planning approvals and the MY-HOME scheme for affordable housing, targeting low-income families and youth.
body_lead: The Tamil Nadu government, on Wednesday (August 5, 2026), announced an AI-enabled planning approval system, integrating multiple agencies, and a new rental housing scheme to develop one lakh housing units in Chennai over the next seven years, as part of the State’s Budget for 2026-27 presented by Finance Minister N. Marie Wilson. In the revised Budget Estimates, ₹8,852 crore has been allocated for the Housing and Urban Development Department, which is an increase from the Interim Budget 2026-27 by the DMK-led Tamil Nadu government, which allocated ₹7,547 crore.
